latest.notes: The stream now recovers on its own from a half-open uplink. When the network dies without the socket ever erroring, the connection stays stuck in 'streaming' — so the reconnect watchdog never fired and the broadcast sat silently dead until something finally errored. The watchdog now also detects that state: if audio is flowing from the player but no bytes have actually gone out since the last check, it treats the uplink as dead and reconnects. It also recovers from a connection attempt that hangs without resolving. A silent station is never mistaken for a dead uplink. Player behaviour is unchanged.
